function.name: get_formatinfo
function.description: This function iterates over the supported_formats array to find a format that matches the input format. If a match is found, it returns a pointer to the matching format. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the format that needs to be matched in the supported_formats array.

function.return_type: struct pixelformatinfo pointer. It represents a pointer to the matching format in the supported_formats array if a match is found, otherwise NULL.

function.name: FormatConverter_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICFormatConverter interface.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier (IID) of the interface being queried for.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv will contain NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL.

function.name: FormatConverter_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the FormatConverter object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IWICFormatConverter interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the FormatConverter object.

function.name: FormatConverter_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources associated with a FormatConverter object. It decrements the reference count, and if it reaches 0, it deletes the critical section, releases the source and palette if they exist, and frees the memory allocated to the FormatConverter object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICFormatConverter interface of the FormatConverter object to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement. If it is 0, the object has been freed.

function.name: FormatConverter_GetSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of the source bitmap. If the source bitmap is not initialized, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICFormatConverter interface

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to a UINT that receives the width of the bitmap

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to a UINT that receives the height of the bitmap

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns the size of the bitmap. If the source bitmap is not initialized, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED.

function.name: FormatConverter_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of the given format converter interface. If the source is not null, it copies the destination format's GUID to the pixel format. If the source is null, it returns an error indicating that the format converter is not initialized.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the format converter interface whose pixel format is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: pPixelFormat
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a variable that receives the pixel format GUID.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds. If the source is null, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED.

function.name: FormatConverter_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of the source bitmap.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICFormatConverter interface

parameters.name: pDpiX
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the horizontal resolution

parameters.name: pDpiY
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the vertical resolution

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the source is initialized, it returns the resolution of the source bitmap. If not, it returns an error code indicating that the source is not initialized.

function.name: FormatConverter_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the color palette from the source to the destination. If the destination palette is not initialized, it initializes it from the source palette.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface to the format converter object.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: This is the palette that will be copied to.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the palette is not initialized, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the source is not initialized or if the destination format is an indexed format, and S_OK (success) otherwise.

function.name: FormatConverter_CopyPixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a source to a destination buffer, with a specific format conversion. If no rectangle is provided, it copies the entire source.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for a format converter.

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the source to copy. If this parameter is NULL, the entire source is copied.

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the destination bitmap. This is the number of bytes between the beginning of one scan line and the beginning of the next scan line.

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: The size of the destination buffer.

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination buffer.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code. In particular, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the source is not set.

function.name: FormatConverter_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a format converter object. It sets up the conversion from one pixel format to another, with optional dithering, palette and alpha threshold.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the format converter object to be initialized

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap

parameters.name: dstFormat
parameters.description: Destination pixel format GUID

parameters.name: dither
parameters.description: Dither type to be used in the conversion

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Pointer to the palette to be used in the conversion

parameters.name: alpha_threshold
parameters.description: Alpha threshold to be used in the conversion

parameters.name: palette_type
parameters.description: Type of palette to be used in the conversion

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation is successful, error code otherwise

function.name: FormatConverter_CanConvert
function.description: This function checks if a conversion between two pixel formats is possible.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICFormatConverter interface

parameters.name: srcPixelFormat
parameters.description: Source pixel format GUID

parameters.name: dstPixelFormat
parameters.description: Destination pixel format GUID

parameters.name: pfCanConvert
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL variable where the function stores the result of whether a conversion is possible or not

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the operation fails

function.name: FormatConverter_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of FormatConverter, initializes it, and assigns the instance to the provided pointer. It also queries an interface based on the provided IID and releases the interface after querying.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: This is the reference to the interface identifier that is to be queried.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the pointer where the created instance of FormatConverter will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, otherwise it returns the result of the interface query operation.
